## Summary

Describe the user-visible or architectural outcome.

## Design

Explain important ownership, security, compatibility, or operational choices.

## Verification

List the commands and environments used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the nearest `AGENTS.md` contract.
- [ ] Public behavior and documentation are updated together.
- [ ] Tests cover success, failure, cleanup, and concurrency where relevant.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer.
